subject: sliderInput working in Firefox but not Chrome after Shiny update from 0.10 to 0.11

messages.author: aee3e25f4c0afac7
messages.subject: sliderInput working in Firefox but not Chrome after Shiny update from 0.10 to 0.11
parts:
The sliderInput appears normally in both browsers, but is not draggable in Chrome. This was only a problem immediately after upgrading to Shiny 0.11. The sliderInput is in a renderUI expression if that is at all relevant.
(question also on SO https://stackoverflow.com/questions/28202551/shiny-sliderinput-not-working-in-chrome-browser)

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: sliderInput working in Firefox but not Chrome after Shiny update from 0.10 to 0.11
parts:
This has been fixed, although you'll need to install the development version:
  https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/issues/700

In Shiny 0.11, the sliders work in all the browsers that we've tested, but there seem to be some configurations that exhibit this problem, and we yet don't know exactly what the conditions are. Can you provide information about the system you're using?

-Winston

body {
